title: Managed Backup: protected capacity band
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines protected capacity band.

## Tier basis

**Protected-capacity price band in gb.** Reference protected source capacity; GB integer.

| Contract tier | Protected-capacity price band in gb |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 5000 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 10000 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 25000 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 50000 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 100000 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 250000 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, protected-capacity price band in GB is 5000.

## Hypothetical comparison

For a hypothetical choice between the smallest and largest listed tiers, protected-capacity price band in GB differs: 5000 for the smallest and 250000 for the largest.
